content.thinking: הכותרת מדברת על קרן השתלמות, ומשם אני סורקת את הטקסט בחיפוש אחרי "6 שנים", "7.5%" ו-"15,712 ₪". המחשבון נמצא למטה, תחת "כמה כסף נשאר לכם, ומתי?", ואני גוללת לשם.

The salary is set at 30,000, and the screen shows 136,457 ₪ left in hand after 64,761 ₪ tax, 135,000 ₪ from the employer and 45,000 ₪ of your own deposits. I'm not sure the pink stripes on the small chart are tax, so I'm skipping that text and moving on.
Fees of up to 2% a year and the 6-year wait before withdrawing are the figures to know; I'm stopping here since the money number is what you came for.

input.answer: If I join on a 30,000 salary, I put in 45,000 ₪ and my employer adds 135,000 ₪. If I take it out after 5 years I'm left with about 136,457 ₪, but around 64,761 ₪ of that goes to tax, so I should wait the 6 years. Worth joining for sure. I'm not sure I got the tax part right.

stuck.why: The minus and the red stripes scared me. I wasn't sure if this tax happens anyway or only because the chart is set to 5 years ('לפני 6 שנים: מס').

stuck.where: Small year chart with bars 1–12, selected at 5
stuck.why: I didn't know if I'm meant to click 6 to see the tax-free version. I didn't touch it.
It felt strange that I end up with less than what went in plus what the employer added, but I didn't add it up.

used: Labels 'לפני 6 שנים: מס' / 'מ־6 שנים: פטור עד התקרה'
Big chart numbers: 136,457 נשאר בידיים, −64,761 המס, +21,218 התשואה, +135,000 המעסיק הוסיף, 45,000 הפקדתם
skipped: Small grey notes under the chart (מסלול, 47% מס, inflation...)
מי מציע ומי מפקח and company names
unsure_meaning: Pink/red striped pieces on the small year bars: guessed it's tax
Dark brown parts of the big bars vs bright yellow
Teal block on top of the 12-year bar
not_found: A clear line saying how much I'd have if I wait the 6 years, without me clicking the bars
What to do first to actually join

findings.what: The default shows withdrawing at 5 years, so the first big thing you see is a scary −64,761 ₪ tax. Nothing big tells you this disappears if you wait 6 years.
The year chart uses colours and stripes with no legend next to them, so I had to guess what pink stripes mean
Every block has the same 'חוקים וכללים · N' chip, the same noise again and again
Lots of small grey assumption text under the chart that I won't read, and it seems to hold the important stuff (tax rate, ceiling)
Final amount is less than my money plus the employer's, and the page doesn't say why in plain words
Fees only shown as percents ('עד 2% בשנה'), which sounds like nothing; no shekel amount
